'''Pacôme Dadiet''' (born 27 July 2005) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL). He previously played for [[Paris Basketball]].

==Early life and career==
Dadiet was born on 27 July 2005 and is of [[Ivory Coast|Ivorian]] descent.<ref name="auto3">{{Cite web|url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/242349/pacome-dadiet|website=Proballers.com|title=Pacome Dadiet}}</ref><ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/fr/player/298550/Pacome--Dadiet|publisher=[[FIBA]]|title=Pacome Dadiet|language=French}}</ref> As a youth, he joined the club {{ill|Saint-Charles Charenton|fr|Saint-Charles Charenton Saint-Maurice Basket-ball}} in 2011, where he remained through 2020 and was teammates with players including [[Tidjane Salaun]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.saintcharlesbasket.fr/articles/50356-tests-d-entree-a-l-insep-3-joueurs-de-la-saint-charles|publisher={{ill|Saint-Charles Charenton|fr|Saint-Charles Charenton Saint-Maurice Basket-ball}}|trans-title=INSEP entry tests: 3 players from Saint Charles|language=French|title=Tests d'entrée à l'INSEP : 3 joueurs de la Saint Charles|date=2020}}</ref> He then spent time with the youth team of [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball]] before joining [[Paris Basketball]].<ref>{{Cite news|newspaper=[[Le Quotidien du Sport]]|language=French|trans-title=The calculated risk of Pacôme Dadiet who chose Ulm, Germany|title=Le risque calculé de Pacôme Dadiet qui a choisi Ulm, en Allemagne|url=https://www.lequotidiendusport.fr/le-crisque-calcule-de-pacome-dadiet-qui-a-choisi-ulm-en-allemagne/|date=16 February 2024|author=Pratdessus, Valérie}}</ref> He appeared in 22 games for the Paris Basketball U21 team in the 2021–22 season and had averages of 17.3 points, 5.2 rebounds and 1.7 assists per game.<ref name="auto">{{Cite magazine|url=https://basketnews.com/news-176627-ulm-bring-another-top-european-talent-to-the-squad.html|magazine=[[Basket News]]|title=Ulm bring another top European talent to the squad|author=Kurth, Florian|date=18 August 2022}}</ref>

==Professional career==
Dadiet made his debut for the Paris Basketball first team, in the [[LNB Pro A]], in October 2021 at the age of 16, totaling seven points in eight minutes of playing time.<ref name="auto2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/7-points-en-8-minutes-les-debuts-reussis-de-pacome-dadiet-16-ans-au-niveau-professionnel|website=BeBasket.fr|title=7 points en 8 minutes : les débuts réussis de Pacôme Dadiet (16 ans) au niveau professionnel|date=21 October 2021|language=French|trans-title=7 points in 8 minutes: the successful debut of Pacôme Dadiet (16 years old) at the professional level}}</ref> He appeared in eight games in the 2021–22 season for the main squad.<ref name="auto3"/>

Dadiet sought to leave Paris and join the German team [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] in 2022 but was involved in a contractual dispute which did not allow him to join them until January 2023.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/mais-ou-est-passe-pacome-dadiet|website=BeBasket.fr|trans-title=But where did Pacôme Dadiet go?|date=26 October 2022|author=Lacoste, Alexandre|title=Mais où est passé Pacôme Dadiet ?|language=French}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://tribune47.com/pacome-dadiet-officiellement-joueur-du-ratiopharm-ulm/|newspaper=[[Tribune 47]]|language=French|trans-title=Pacôme Dadiet officially a Ratiopharm Ulm player|date=16 January 2023|title=Pacôme Dadiet officiellement joueur du Ratiopharm Ulm}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|author=Lacoste, Alexandre|date=13 January 2023|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/de-paris-a-ulm-pacome-dadiet-enfin-libere|language=French|website=BeBasket.fr|trans-title=From Paris to Ulm, Pacôme Dadiet (finally) released|title=De Paris à Ulm, Pacôme Dadiet (enfin) libéré}}</ref> He played for the Ulm developmental team, [[OrangeAcademy]], in the German third tier, in the 2022–23 season, averaging 16 points and 4.2 rebounds per game.<ref name="auto3"/> He also appeared in one game for the first team, playing three minutes.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/international/players/pacome-dadiet-1.html|website=[[Basketball-Reference.com]]|title=Pacome Dadiet International Stats}}</ref> He became a regular player for Ulm in the 2023–24 season and has been viewed as a potential [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) prospect.<ref name="auto3"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-frances-pacome-dadiet|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: France's Pacome Dadiet|date=1 January 2024}}</ref>

==National team career==
Dadiet represented France at the [[2021 FIBA U16 European Challengers]], where he played five games and averaged six points and 1.4 rebounds.<ref name="auto1"/> He later participated at the [[2022 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup]] and helped France win the bronze medal while averaging 4.3 points, 2.2 assists and 1.4 rebounds per game.<ref name="auto"/>

==Personal life==
Dadiet's older brother, Maxence, also is a basketball player and has been a member of the [[Ivory Coast men's national basketball team]].<ref name="auto2"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/le-retour-fracassant-de-pacome-dadiet|website=BeBasket.fr|title=Le retour fracassant de Pacôme Dadiet|author=Pantel-Jouve, Gabriel|date=9 July 2022|language=French|trans-title=The shattering return of Pacôme Dadiet}}</ref>
